items.title: Corner-radius token for compact/table controls
items.observed: Primary/secondary buttons use the 8px radius token; table row-action and pagination buttons render at 6px.
items.recommendation: Decide whether compact controls should follow the 8px token or a dedicated documented small-control radius, then apply consistently across the estate.

items.title: Single input-stroke token for inputs and selects
items.observed: Text inputs use a #d1d5db border while filter selects use a lighter #e5e7eb border.
items.recommendation: Define one input-stroke token and bind both text inputs and selects to it.

items.title: Add the extra State dashboard sections to the frame
items.observed: The live State Authority dashboard renders 'Case Status Breakdown' and 'Stale Cases' sections below the designed content; they follow the shared card/chart language.
items.recommendation: Fold these two sections into the State dashboard Figma frame so the composition is specified.

items.title: Add the extra System-Admin filter + nav to the frame
items.observed: The live grievance-monitoring screen adds an 'All Cases' filter, a 'Reset' button and a 'Grievance Categories' sidebar item, not present in the design frame; all conform to the visual language.
items.recommendation: Add these controls to the System-Administrator frames so the toolbar and sidebar are fully specified.

items.title: Specify the profile menu (avatar dropdown)
items.observed: The build's masthead avatar opens a profile dropdown (with a chevron); the design shows only the avatar.
items.recommendation: Decide the profile-menu pattern and add it to the design (avatar-as-trigger, chevron optional) so design and build match.

items.title: Document the citizen floating chatbot/emblem widget
items.observed: The citizen pages show a second floating widget (an emblem/chatbot bubble) besides the accessibility launcher; it is not in the design.
items.recommendation: Add the chatbot widget to the design (placement, size, states) or remove it if unintended; keep it from overlapping page content.

items.title: Fix frame-name corruption in the handoff file
items.observed: Several frames are mis-parented/mis-named — e.g. a 'District-Officer/Notifications' frame sits inside the State Authority section, and 'Central-Authority/Fund-Allocation' is reused for both Reports and Notifications.
items.recommendation: Rename/re-parent the affected frames to their correct role/screen so the handoff maps cleanly to the build routes.

items.title: Design the System-Admin analytics screens
items.observed: Officer Performance, Grievance Analytics and Geographic View exist in the build but have no Figma frames.
items.recommendation: Produce frames for these; the build versions reuse the shared shell/cards/charts and are a reasonable starting point.

items.title: Design the Central Authority screens
items.observed: Central Authority Dashboard, State Comparison and Scheme Performance are built but undesigned.
items.recommendation: Produce frames; the build conforms to the visual language and can seed the design.

items.title: Design the Finance Fund-Utilisation report
items.observed: The Finance 'Fund Utilisation Report' screen is built but has no Figma frame.
items.recommendation: Produce a frame consistent with the other Finance screens.
